metrics_md: Variants: baseline = full minified JSON; v1 = only the query's fields as minified JSON (the API's own `fields` parameter); v2 = ContextQuant json (query fields + notes on what was left out); v3 = ContextQuant tsv. Correct = programmatic check against answers computed from the fixture (eval/harness.ts). Made-up answer = on left-out questions, the model named a school although the data it saw had none. Ctx tokens = o200k tokens of the tool result shown. Overflow = prompt longer than the local model's 32k window (row marked truncated).
